segments.text: A reckless and flashy Inferno assassin fueled by a burning desire for revenge. Drei prefers to carry out missions her own way and shows little respect for her superiors. She likes to settle matters with an old-fashioned Western duel. Her name means "three" in German.
weapon of choice: Smith & Wesson M5906 (9mm Semi Automatic Pistol)
Former Delta Force operative. Isaac's most loyal killer and bodyguard. Though not as good as Phantom, he's the next best thing.
Now answers only to Isaac and rarely accepts hits that aren't specifically requested by him.
A gunrunner for Inferno and a top of the line US Navy Seal.
He's offered up as a sacrifice to show off and test
Zwei's abilities, becoming his first kill.

A young man with no recollection of his past. He was at the wrong place at the wrong time and has since become the captive of the Inferno syndicate. After being brainwashed by the Scythe Master, he is given little choice but to learn the ways of an assassin. The name "Zwei" means "two" in German.
Weapon of choice: SIG Sauer P226 (9mm Semi Automatic Pistol).

Inferno's top assassin. Like Zwei, she is without a past and calmly follows her orders without question. Apathetic and aloof, she acts as Zwei's mentor as he learns what it takes to become an assassin. Her name means "one" in German.
Weapon of choice: Colt Python (.357 Double Action Revolver).

cast.characterName: キャル ディヴェンス
cast.originalCharacterName: キャル ディヴェンス

segments.text: A young girl raised in the streets of South Central L.A., she witnessed the death of her best friend during a botched deal between Inferno and the Yakuza. Cal is playful, energetic, and kind-hearted, but would give anything to avenge her friend's death.
Weapon of choice: Steyr AUG (Bullpup Assault Rifle).

cast.characterName: クロウディア マッキェネン
cast.originalCharacterName: クロウディア マッキェネン

segments.text: A mysterious young woman who sits on Inferno's Executive Council. She has a troubled past that she has all but put behind her and quickly takes a liking to
Zwei. Her nickname, "Clau" ("Kuro"), means "black" in Japanese.
Weapon of choice: AMT Backup (.380 automatic Colt Pistol).
Godou's kid sister. Gentle, mild-mannered, and extremely shy, she has been raised believing that her older brother is actually her uncle. She is unaware of her connection to the Yakuza.

cast.characterName: ヘルムート・フォン・ジュゼッペ
cast.originalCharacterName: ヘルムート・フォン・ジュゼッペ

segments.text: A former neurologist for the Stasi, he excels at brainwashing and manipulation. A collector of antique guns and weaponry, he is responsible for both Ein and Zwei's amnesia.
Weapon of choice: Luger P08 (Semi Automatic Pistol).

cast.characterName: リズィ ガーランド
cast.originalCharacterName: リズィ ガーランド

segments.text: Claudia's best friend and confidante, she is fiercely devoted to both her friends and Inferno. Whenever she is not acting as Claudia's bodyguard, she can be found on the front lines with the rest of Inferno's forces.
Weapon of choice: AMT Hardballer Longslide (.45 Automatic Colt Pistol).

cast.characterName: アイザック ワイズメル
cast.originalCharacterName: アイザック ワイズメル

segments.text: Leader of the Bloodies gang in Los Angeles and co-founder of Inferno. He loses his composure rather easily and openly shows his distrust for Claudia.

cast.characterName: レイモンド マグワイヤ
cast.originalCharacterName: レイモンド マグワイヤ

segments.text: A Colombian drug kingpin and co-founder of Inferno. Quiet and composed, he is the driving force behind Inferno.
Godou's longtime friend and second-in-command. Always cool and in control, he keeps Godo from going overboard whenever he loses his temper.
Son of the current head of the Godou family, he is next-in-line as the leader of the Yakuza. Foul-mouthed and hotheaded, he is kept in check by his right-hand man, Shiga.
Weapon of choice: Beretta M93R (9mm Machine Pistol).

Father of Godou Daisuke and Fujieda Mio, and leader of the Yakuza. To protect Mio from being used as a bargaining chip during underworld transactions, he separated from his wife while Mio was still an infant and had her take his wife's maiden name. He bears a strong hatred for anyone who would use his family to manipulate him.
Mio's meddlesome friend. She's energetic and in love with the idea of being in love.
Mio's classmate.
The game has a voiced narration, which is performed by a different voice actor than any of the characters.
